record.title: Preserve supported recorder strings through TOML records
record.intent: Keep the recorder value contract consistent with the artifacts consumed by its child bootstrap.
requirements: Preserve the construction-only reproducer showing accepted DEL-bearing arguments and readiness cannot be parsed after existing TOML serialization.
Encode supported Unicode scalar strings into valid TOML without changing their value or broadening process arguments, keeping private invalid content out of diagnostics.
Exercise launch readiness terminal and reconciliation string records with parser round trips and a fixed synthetic child, including installed distributions.
acceptance: Every tested supported string retains its exact value through the emitted TOML and valid child ownership remains bounded.
